eps.o: When Zola steals the Rescue-Webs Firetruck, he learns that being a hero isn't so easy.
When Symbie slimes the city, Team Spidey chases him to his Slime Factory to stop him.
Spidey helps Mr. Fantastic when his hiccups cause him to change shapes.
After a potion turns them into kittens, Spidey and Spin must get creative to defeat Lizard.
Team Spidey must stop Green Goblin from controlling Zola with a remote.
Spidey, Ghost-Spider, and Mr. Fantastic must get a super-powered belt back from Black Cat.
When Sandman causes trouble on a mountain, Team Spidey uses their Rescue-Webs vehicles to stop him.
Rocket & Groot help Spidey save a stolen pufferfish from Lizard.
Aunt May's house flies away after Peter leaves Doc Ock's Octo-Floater in his room.
When Swarm sets her robo-flies on the city, Team Spidey uses their spider knowledge to stop them.
Inspired by her favorite movie Spaghetti-Zilla, Aunt May decides to act like the monster from the film in the remake.
When Electro drains too much electricity, she starts going on the fritz every time she sneezes, so Team Spidey must stop it.
When Symbie creates creatures called Blobbies to cause chaos, Ghost Spider must stop them despite having a bad cold.
Silk overshadows Spidey while trying to stop Gobby and his Farm-Critter Zapper from switching farm animals at the zoo.
Gobby disguises himself as a leprechaun in order to ruin the St Patrick's Day festival with his new Sneezy-Shamrock Pumpkin Pranks.
When White Tiger and Spin go missing, Spidey and Ghost Spider must work together to rescue the two in time.
Team Spidey and their new friend Silk must stop Doc Ock from using her Slo-Go Ray.
Team Spidey must retrieve their stolen web-shooters.
Spidey, Rocket, and Groot save a beautiful day from Green Goblin's prank machine.
Team Spidey helps Jeff the Land Shark after he loses a tooth and is captured by Doc Ock.
